# ECN-2026-041 Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Reason for change
This engineering change notice updates the mandrel clamp bolt torque requirement for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Recent inspection findings and supplier review indicated inconsistent clamp preload during routine maintenance. The change corrects the published target torque to ensure consistent mandrel seating, reduce slippage risk during ring formation, and improve repeatability of ring concentricity. Referenced maintenance and operating procedures have been reviewed to align with this requirement.

Affected items
- Mandrel clamp bolts on EQ-P1-L2-RR01.  
- Maintenance procedures that reference clamp bolt torque settings in the equipment file for P1-L2.  
- Tooling setup instructions used by operators on P1-L2.

Implementation
- Update maintenance documentation to state the mandrel clamp bolt torque for EQ-P1-L2-RR01 as 395 N·m.  
- Perform a controlled implementation during the next scheduled maintenance opportunity by trained maintenance personnel following SOP-P1-L2-02 and SOP-P1-L2-05.  
- Verify correct torque application using calibrated torque wrench and record results in the equipment maintenance log.  
- Confirm mandrel seating and run a controlled tooling check to ensure ring geometry remains within production acceptance criteria after torque application.  
- Notify operations and maintenance teams of the change and ensure training materials are amended to reflect the updated torque requirement.

Approvals
Approved by maintenance engineering and operations supervision. Changes documented in the equipment file and cross-referenced to related documents: MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1, SOP-P1-L2-02, SOP-P1-L2-05. Record of approval and implementation evidence to be filed with the ECN record and equipment history.
